definitions.explanation: An image captured by a camera. One of the most common words for talking about pictures.

examples.japanese: {写真|しゃしん}を{撮|と}ってもいいですか。
この{写真|しゃしん}はどこで{撮|と}りましたか。
examples.english: Where did you take this photo?

examples.japanese: {写真|しゃしん}を{見|み}せてください。
この{写真|しゃしん}は{去年|きょねん}の{夏|なつ}に{撮|と}りました。{海|うみ}がきれいでした。
examples.english: I took this photo last summer. The ocean was beautiful.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}と{写真|しゃしん}を{撮|と}りたかったですが、カメラを{忘|わす}れました。とても{残念|ざんねん}でした。
examples.english: I wanted to take a photo with my friend, but I forgot my camera. I was very disappointed.

notes:
{写真|しゃしん} means photograph. The kanji mean {写|しゃ} (copy/reproduce) + {真|しん} (truth) - capturing reality.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {写真|しゃしん}を{撮|と}る: to take a photo
- {写真|しゃしん}を{見|み}る: to look at a photo
- {写真|しゃしん}に{写|うつ}る: to appear in a photo
- {写真|しゃしん}{写|うつ}りがいい: to be photogenic

RELATED TERMS:
- {自撮|じど}り/セルフィー: selfie
- {集合|しゅうごう}{写真|しゃしん}: group photo
- {証明|しょうめい}{写真|しゃしん}: ID photo
- {写真家|しゃしんか}: photographer

CONTRAST:
- {写真|しゃしん}: photograph (camera)
- {絵|え}: picture, drawing, painting (by hand)
- {画像|がぞう}: image (digital/general term)
